title: Remove Elements by Type and Color
statement: The task is to decide whether a sequence of up to 10^5 elements, each with a type and color, can be fully erased when one move deletes exactly groupSize[type] adjacent elements sharing both type and color and the rest close up. Because removal order never matters, a stack of (type, color, run count) that pops a run once it reaches its group size decides it, like removing adjacent duplicates.
